en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Sevdah-style lament, treated as traditional though I am not certain. 'Субдо' in stanza 3 is a typo for 'судбо'. 'Нема кој да ме превира' is my reading: 'no one to look after / console me'.

lines.cyr: што грев стори, ти што ме запусти?
lines.lat: što grev stori, ti što me zapusti?
lines.en: what sin did I commit, you who abandoned me?

lines.cyr: Мојта младост ти ми ја поцрне,
lines.lat: Mojta mladost ti mi ja pocrne,
lines.en: You blackened my youth for me,
I had a sweetheart, and he left me.

lines.cyr: Што бре судбо јазе ти направив,
lines.lat: Što bre sudbo jaze ti napraviv,
lines.en: What, hey fate, did I do to you,

lines.cyr: цел век судбо болка ми остави?
lines.lat: cel vek sudbo bolka mi ostavi?
lines.en: fate, you left me pain for a whole lifetime?

lines.cyr: Дојде време с' либе се разделив,
lines.lat: Dojde vreme s' libe se razdeliv,
lines.en: The time came when I parted from my love,

lines.cyr: солзи ронам и со душа зборам.
lines.lat: solzi ronam i so duša zboram.
lines.en: I shed tears and speak with my soul.
Why, my love, did you leave me,
we loved each other for three years?
I lost my aching heart for you,

lines.cyr: лоша дума јазе не ти реков.
lines.lat: loša duma jaze ne ti rekov.
lines.en: I never said an evil word to you.
why, fate, did you curse me?
I remained an orphan without kin,

lines.cyr: немам судбо кој да ме превира.
lines.lat: nemam sudbo koj da me previra.
lines.en: I have no one, fate, to look after me.
Far away into the wilderness I will go,

lines.cyr: кај што судбо сонце не огрева.
lines.lat: kaj što sudbo sonce ne ogreva.
lines.en: where, fate, the sun does not warm.
